meaning: to set up or establish (an office, a post, a program)

senses.en: to set up or establish (an office, a post, a program)

note: Used for institutions and formal bodies: 设立 + 机构/办公室/专业.

examples.zh: 公司打算在上海设立一个新办公室。
examples.en: The company plans to set up a new office in Shanghai.

examples.zh: 学校去年设立了一个新专业。
examples.en: The school established a new major last year.

examples.zh: 医院为老人设立了一个专门的地方吗？
examples.en: Did the hospital set up a special place for older people?

meaning: to build up, construct (cities, a country); construction, development

senses.en: to build up, construct (cities, a country); construction, development

note: Large-scale building: 城市建设, 国家建设; for a single house use 盖/建.

examples.zh: 这座城市正在建设新的地铁。
examples.en: This city is building a new subway.

examples.zh: 家乡的建设越来越好了。
examples.en: My hometown's development is getting better and better.

examples.zh: 国家的建设需要很多人才。
examples.en: Building up the country takes a lot of talented people.

meaning: to innovate; innovation

senses.en: to innovate; innovation

note: Often 科技创新, 创新能力; usually positive.

examples.zh: 只用旧办法不行，我们要创新。
examples.en: Using only old methods won't work; we need to innovate.

examples.zh: 这家公司的创新能力很强。
examples.en: This company has strong innovation ability.

examples.zh: 做事需要创新，也需要努力。
examples.en: Work needs innovation, and it needs effort too.

meaning: almost, nearly, close to (a number or amount)

senses.en: almost, nearly, close to (a number or amount)

note: Comes before a number: 将近 + number + measure word; the amount is just under the figure.

examples.zh: 我等了将近一个小时。
examples.en: I waited for almost an hour.

examples.zh: 他将近五十岁了，身体还很好。
examples.en: He is nearly fifty, and his health is still good.

examples.zh: 到机场要将近两个小时吗？
examples.en: Does it take almost two hours to get to the airport?

meaning: climate (the long-term weather pattern of a place)

senses.en: climate (the long-term weather pattern of a place)

note: 气候 is the long-term pattern; 天气 is today's weather.

examples.zh: 南方的气候很热，也常常下雨。
examples.en: The climate in the south is hot, and it often rains.

examples.zh: 这里的气候对身体好吗？
examples.en: Is the climate here good for your health?

examples.zh: 我不太习惯北京的气候。
examples.en: I'm not very used to Beijing's climate.

meaning: postage stamp

senses.en: postage stamp

examples.zh: 我想买两张邮票。
examples.en: I'd like to buy two stamps.

examples.zh: 这封信要用几张邮票？
examples.en: How many stamps does this letter need?

examples.zh: 我弟弟有很多旧邮票。
examples.en: My younger brother has lots of old stamps.

meaning: developed, advanced (of an economy, region, industry)

senses.en: developed, advanced (of an economy, region, industry)

note: Said of places and fields: 经济发达, 交通发达, 发达国家.

examples.zh: 中国东部的经济比较发达。
examples.en: The economy in eastern China is relatively developed.

examples.zh: 这个城市的交通很发达。
examples.en: This city has a very well-developed transport network.

examples.zh: 在发达国家，很多人用手机买东西。
examples.en: In developed countries, many people shop with their phones.

meaning: forecast; to forecast (mostly weather)

senses.en: forecast; to forecast (mostly weather)

note: Most common in 天气预报 (weather forecast).

examples.zh: 天气预报说明天有雨。
examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你看了今天的天气预报吗？
examples.en: Did you check today's weather forecast?

examples.zh: 广播里预报，周末会很冷。
examples.en: The radio forecast says it will be very cold this weekend.

meaning: hometown, native place

senses.en: hometown, native place

note: Warmer and more literary than 老家; often said with feeling.

examples.zh: 他离开故乡已经十年了。
examples.en: He left his hometown ten years ago.

examples.zh: 你的故乡在哪儿？
examples.en: Where is your hometown?

examples.zh: 过年我想回故乡看父母。
examples.en: At New Year I want to go back to my hometown to see my parents.

meaning: to get a haircut; to cut someone's hair

senses.en: to get a haircut; to cut someone's hair

note: Separable verb: 理了发, 理个发.

examples.zh: 我周末想去理发。
examples.en: I want to get a haircut this weekend.

examples.zh: 他每个月都去理发。
examples.en: He gets a haircut every month.

examples.zh: 请问，哪里可以理发？
examples.en: Excuse me, where can I get a haircut?

meaning: to advocate, hold that; a stand or view

senses.en: to advocate, hold that; a stand or view

examples.zh: 我主张先做检查，再吃药。
examples.en: I think we should do tests first and take medicine afterward.

examples.zh: 他的主张很清楚。
examples.en: His position is very clear.

examples.zh: 老师主张学生多说汉语。
examples.en: The teacher advocates that students speak more Chinese.

meaning: short-term

senses.en: short-term

note: Opposite: 长期. Usually modifies a noun: 短期课程, 短期工作.

examples.zh: 我只想找一份短期工作。
examples.en: I only want to find a short-term job.

examples.zh: 这是一个短期的课程。
examples.en: This is a short-term course.

examples.zh: 短期来看，这样做对公司有好处。
examples.en: In the short term, doing it this way benefits the company.

meaning: leather handbag or briefcase

senses.en: leather handbag or briefcase

examples.zh: 我的皮包放在椅子上了。
examples.en: I left my handbag on the chair.

examples.zh: 这个皮包多少钱？
examples.en: How much is this handbag?

examples.zh: 他给妈妈买了一个新皮包。
examples.en: He bought his mom a new handbag.

meaning: vivid, lively (of speech, writing, description)

senses.en: vivid, lively (of speech, writing, description)

examples.zh: 老师讲得很生动。
examples.en: The teacher explains things very vividly.

examples.zh: 这篇文章写得不够生动。
examples.en: This article isn't written vividly enough.

examples.zh: 他的故事很生动，孩子们都爱听。
examples.en: His stories are vivid, and the kids all love to listen.

meaning: neat, tidy, orderly

senses.en: neat, tidy, orderly

examples.zh: 他的房间很干净，也很整齐。
examples.en: His room is clean and tidy.

examples.zh: 请把书放整齐。
examples.en: Please put the books away neatly.

examples.zh: 孩子们排得很整齐。
examples.en: The children lined up in neat rows.

meaning: to total, there are ... altogether

senses.en: to total, there are ... altogether

note: Followed by a number: 共有 + number + noun.

examples.zh: 我们班共有二十个学生。
examples.en: Our class has twenty students in total.

examples.zh: 这个楼共有几层？
examples.en: How many floors does this building have in total?

examples.zh: 一年共有十二个月。
examples.en: There are twelve months in a year.

meaning: around, about (a point in time); front and back

senses.en: around, about (a point in time); front and back

note: After a time word, it means "around then": 春节前后.

examples.zh: 春节前后，机票特别贵。
examples.en: Around the Spring Festival, plane tickets are especially expensive.

examples.zh: 我学汉语前后学了两年。
examples.en: I studied Chinese for about two years in total.

examples.zh: 房子的前后都有树。
examples.en: There are trees at both the front and the back of the house.

meaning: to photocopy

senses.en: to photocopy

examples.zh: 请帮我复印一下这张纸。
examples.en: Please photocopy this sheet for me.

examples.zh: 这里可以复印吗？
examples.en: Can I make photocopies here?

examples.zh: 我要复印三份，多少钱？
examples.en: I need three copies; how much is it?

meaning: to open for business, start operating

senses.en: to open for business, start operating

note: Separable verb; for a shop's first opening, not for daily opening hours.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆下个月开业。
examples.en: This restaurant opens next month.

examples.zh: 新医院什么时候开业？
examples.en: When will the new hospital open?

examples.zh: 他刚开业，生意还不太好。
examples.en: He just opened, and business isn't very good yet.

meaning: to push forward, promote, drive (a plan or development)

senses.en: to push forward, promote, drive (a plan or development)

note: The object is usually abstract: 推动发展/合作/计划.

examples.zh: 国家想推动经济发展。
examples.en: The country wants to promote economic development.

examples.zh: 手机推动了生活的变化。
examples.en: Mobile phones have driven changes in daily life.

examples.zh: 我们要一起推动这个计划。
examples.en: We need to push this plan forward together.
